mapper.select: SELECT a.amount,l.paid_amount FROM expense_adjustment a JOIN ledger_entry l ON l.id=a.original_expense_id WHERE a.id=#{p.id} AND a.status='TRASHED' AND a.purge_after>#{p.now} AND a.version=#{p.version} AND l.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE OF a,l

SELECT COALESCE(sum(active.amount),0) FROM expense_adjustment active WHERE active.original_expense_id=(SELECT original_expense_id FROM expense_adjustment WHERE id=#{p.id}) AND active.status='EFFECTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE expense_adjustment a SET status='EFFECTIVE',deleted_at=NULL,purge_after=NULL, updated_at=#{p.now},version=version+1 WHERE a.id=#{p.id} AND a.status='TRASHED' AND a.purge_after>#{p.now} AND a.version=#{p.version} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.id=a.original_expense_id AND l.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND l.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=#{p.id} AND lifecycle_status='TRASHED' AND version=#{p.version} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=#{p.id} AND lifecycle_status='TRASHED' AND version=#{p.version}
mapper.update: DELETE FROM expense_adjustment WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='TRASHED' AND version=#{p.version}
